browser.assertionCorrection: Case-insensitive estimate warning comparison corrected in QA only; actual cases completed before initial QA assertion failure. Adversarial phase rerun separately.

assumptions.networkScenario: One network request per due unique URL; source health, memo reuse and actual due times can reduce demand.
assumptions.checkpointSizeBasis: Reported previous expanded ledger size; not present or remeasured here. Beta must preserve the whole state, not replace it with a smaller cohort ledger.

beta_source_demand.excludedRequestCosts: SEC changed-issuer metadata/index, robots refresh, bounded retries and weekly discovery; quantify separately from observed runs.
beta_source_demand.generationRetention: Two public and two private slots; generation count does not multiply retained snapshot storage.
beta_source_demand.limits: Estimates omit user-delivery GET traffic and long-term ledger event growth. Conditional GET saves bytes, not request count. Do not treat reference free-tier limits as guaranteed billing.
